anya: FYI after the kernel-selector rollout I'm seeing a host-side CPU uplift on proxy nodes. p99 tokenization time spiked and grpc small-write syscalls went nuts. Flame top attached below. Anyone around to triage? :thinking:

ben: which pool/region? paste the flame or top stacks + syscall counters. my initial hunch is increased write syscalls from fragmented streaming frames.

anya: eu-central proxy pool. flame sample (summary):
```
  50% host::tokenize_serialize
  30% net::grpc::emit_small_writev
  12% parse::stream_split
  8% kernel::fallback_path
```
writev ~7-11 calls per 1KB output.

rachel: we also saw kvcache eviction spikes and a drop in hit-rate around the same time. could be batching window oscillation combined with prefetch ordering.

ben: did you try toggling kernel_prefetch or increasing batch.window_ms? I suspect eager-kernel pulls serialization onto the host earlier which helps tiny flows but hurts long sequences (warmer cache slower).

anya: ran a quick canary with kernel_prefetch=on + window_ms=2: small req CPU -9% but long p99 +4%. kvcache hit dropped from 0.84 to 0.69 during spike, evictions/sec rose 300->1100. writev count for small reqs dropped 13->3, long reqs rose 18->29.

ben: propose a small matrix:
- A: prefetch=off, window_ms=2 (baseline)
- B: prefetch=on, window_ms=2
- C: prefetch=on, window_ms=12
- D: prefetch=on, window_ms=12 + microbatch(count=3,max_delay_ms=6)
Run mixed synthetic (95% small/5% long). Capture p50/p95/p99 cpu, tokenize wall, writev/syscalls/request, per-shard kvcache histograms.

anya: infra-bot spun up canaries (canary-c-3669991300). /perf run --matrix=C --trace=flame,kvcache,syscalls posted.

infra-bot: canary-c-3669991300 deployed (start 3669991300). health checks passing.

qa-bot: perf results available: https://perf.internal/runs/36699913 (summary CSV + flames). preliminary C results: small req CPU -6%, long p99 +2.3%, kvcache hit improved to 0.77, evictions/sec down to ~620, writev slightly lower overall.

ben: looks like window_ms=12 mitigates evictions but microbatcher likely needed for mixed workload. action items:
- rachel: run full A/B/C/D matrix and upload CSVs + per-shard histos.
- ben: add serialize_ns microbench for kernel variants and add to kernel-picker CI gate.
- anya: file PERF ticket with hypothesis + recommended interim flags (prefetch=on, window_ms=12, microbatch count=3,max_delay=6ms) and attach flames/CSVs.

anya: will file PERF-2021 and include rollback steps. will update when matrix CSVs finish. :thumbsup:
